resources.string: OrderPilot reads on-screen content only from the courier apps Uber Driver, Wolt Courier, Glovo Courier and Bolt Food in order to detect new offers and display the calculated hourly rate (PLN/h) on an overlay. Screen data is processed exclusively on your device, is never transmitted off-device and is never persistently stored. You can disable the service at any time in system settings.

Tap Start to listen for offers

Turn OrderPilot OFF and ON again in:\nAccessibility → Installed apps → OrderPilot

When an offer appears in your courier app, OrderPilot shows a bar like this on top of it, with the rate already calculated:
green = worth it · yellow = so-so · red = skip it
I ride with OrderPilot — a bar over the courier app instantly shows whether an offer is worth it (PLN/h, PLN/km). Free, no sign-in: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.orderpilot.app
To make the bar work, we\'ll turn on a few phone settings together. It takes about a minute.
Bar on top of the courier app
OrderPilot needs the \"display over other apps\" permission — without it the bar can\'t appear above the offer screen.
1. Tap the button below\n2. Find \"OrderPilot\" and turn the switch on\n3. Come back here (back arrow)
✓ It works! The bar at the top of the screen is a preview — that\'s how it will look over offers.
This service lets OrderPilot read the offer\'s amount, time and distance. It reads courier apps only, and no data ever leaves your phone.

1. Tap the button below
2. Find "OrderPilot" (sometimes under "Installed apps" or "Downloaded apps")
3. Turn it on and confirm "Allow"
4. Come back here
Your phone will show a full-control warning — that\'s the standard system message for every accessibility service. OrderPilot uses it only to read offers.
If your phone stops the monitoring mid-shift, OrderPilot will alert you right away with a notification. Without this you could be driving with the bar silently off.
Notifications are blocked. Enable them in settings: Notifications → OrderPilot → Allow.
Phones put background apps to sleep by default. Disable battery optimization for OrderPilot so the bar keeps working for the whole shift — even with the screen off.

1. Tap the button below
2. Find "OrderPilot" on the list
3. Choose "Unrestricted" or "Don't optimize"
4. Come back here
Phones of this brand additionally kill background apps. These settings keep the bar alive during your shift — worth doing now.
OrderPilot is configured. Start monitoring, minimize the app and wait for offers — the bar will appear on its own.
Tip: offer reading is most reliable when your courier app is set to Polish or English.

Before enabling the accessibility service, please read what it will be used for.

OrderPilot is a tool for couriers. It needs two permissions to operate: the Accessibility Service and permission to display over other apps.

Which apps OrderPilot reads:
exclusively Uber Driver, Uber Eats Courier, Wolt Courier, Glovo Courier and Bolt Food. No other apps are observed.

What exactly is read from the screen:
• offer amount (PLN)
• estimated delivery time (min)
• distance (km)
• whether the offer is a cash order

What this data is used for:
to compute an hourly rate (PLN/h) and display a colored bar on top of the courier app so you can quickly decide whether an offer is worth accepting.

What is NOT done:
• data is not sent to any server
• data is not stored on disk (held in memory for at most ~30 seconds)
• data is not shared with third parties
• data is not used for advertising or profiling

System permissions:
If you accept now, you will go through a short wizard that will ask you to enable a few system settings. Everything is granted manually — OrderPilot never turns anything on for you.

You can disable the service at any time in System Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → OrderPilot. Uninstalling the app removes all local data.
